When `serialize_findings` exceeds its 8,000-byte cap, it drops the oldest open findings. `compose_with_findings` still computes the verdict and sections from the full `merged` list. The comment can therefore display and count open findings that its hidden state does not persist. The next publish reads the shorter block and can lose those findings.
